description: This file defines the DataGroup entity class for the OrangeHRM project, which maps to the 'ohrm_data_group' database table and includes properties such as id, name, description, and permission flags, along with ORM annotations for Doctrine ORM integration.

classes.name: DataGroup
classes.description: Entity class representing a data group with associated access permissions, mapped to the 'ohrm_data_group' table in the database.

methods.description: Returns the ID of the DataGroup.
